newsitem.title: FINLAND: Benefon rises further on GSM type approval.
newsitem.headline: Benefon rises further on GSM type approval.

text.p: Shares in Finnish mobile phones maker Benefon Oy rose in active trade on Tuesday, building on Monday's gains when the company announced it had received type approval for its first GSM handset, brokers said.
At 1405/1205 GMT, Benefon traded at 109.00 markka up 10.80 markka or 11 percent. Turnover was lively for Benefon at over nine million markka.
Benefon announced on Monday it had received type approval for its first GSM (Global Systems for Mobile Communications) handset, the Benefon Gamma.
Brokers said the surge on Tuesday in the share had been fuelled partly by an interview with Benefon CEO Jorma Nieminen in business daily Kauppalehti.
They saw scope for the stock to break 110.00 markka later today.
"The key question is now whether the phone is the same one they presented a year and a half ago or whether they have further developed the model," one senior broker said.
"If they have -- the share rise is justified," he added.
